arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_transactions FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 500000
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose amount is more than $5,000, using the amount in cents (500000). This includes unlabelled transactions.
assumptions: 'More than $5,000' means amount_usd_cents > 500000, so exactly $5,000.00 is excluded.
Counts all transactions, labelled or not, since the question asks how many there are.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Negative amounts are not counted, since they are below the threshold.
